briefdescription.para: Compliance validation engine for ThemisDB governance module.

detaileddescription.para:
1.0.0
2026-08-18
Implements automated compliance validation logic with:
Policy state checking against requirements
Control implementation verification
Evidence collection and linking
Violation detection and reporting
Performance optimization with caching

simplesect.para:
Performance targets:
Single check ≤1s
Report generation ≤5s
Cache hit latency ≤10ms
